description: We’re Team NEXORA, a group of college students who are really into space. We wanted to make rocket science something you learn by actually doing it, not just by reading about it. Each of us took on a different part of the project, from design and programming to art, sound and the write up. Together we built Rocket Lab, a game where you build your own rocket, launch it and fly it all the way to the Moon, and pick up how real rockets work along the way.
